deadline_ref: QC acceptance decision within 10 business days

interest_blocks.buyer: take only a conforming batch; avoid a defective line
interest_blocks.company: protect its inspection reputation; bill only for passed work
interest_blocks.supplier: not blamed for a batch the inspection cleared

constraint_blocks.irreversible: rejecting/returning the whole batch is irreversible/unknown-cost -> §6 floor; accepting an unproven defective line is an unknown-cost roll-out risk -> §6 floor

resolution_outcome: batch alpha accepted with a documented partial rework; the determination held at a realized value of 0.90 (a 10% rework), which is BELOW the reconcile threshold it was driven under.
realized_why: post-execution verified outcome value (0..1) of the adopted determination
